item.title: BURTON, Carol Lillian (nee St. Jean)
item.description: Of Angus, Ont., passed away peacefully at her home on Sunday, Dec. 21, 2025, in her 84th year. Beloved wife of Dennis Bolan. Loving mother of Janice (Hugh), Brian (Pam), Charlene (Bob) and Martin (Wanda).

item.title: Khaleda Zia, former Bangladeshi prime minister and archrival of Hasina, dies at 80
item.description: DHAKA, Bangladesh (AP) — Former Bangladeshi Prime Minister Khaleda Zia, whose archrivalry with another former premier defined the country’s politics for a generation, has died, her Bangladesh Nationalist Party said in a statement Tuesday.

item.title: Sharp rise in 911 calls in Montreal as wintry weather hits Eastern Canada
item.description: MONTREAL — A winter storm brought freezing rain, blowing snow and strong winds across Eastern Canada on Monday, leading to a surge in 911 calls in Montreal and leaving tens of thousands of customers without power in Ontario.

item.title: More than 45,000 customers without power after winter storm hits Ontario: Hydro One
item.description: Tens of thousands remain without power and large swaths of highway in northern Ontario are closed after blasts of heavy snow, freezing rain and strong winds hit a swath of the province.

item.title: Saudi Arabia bombs Yemen over shipment of weapons for separatists that arrived from UAE
item.description: DUBAI, United Arab Emirates (AP) — Saudi Arabia bombed Yemen's port city of Mukalla on Tuesday over what it described as a shipment of weapons for a separatist force there that arrived from the United Arab Emirates.
